svg.title: To Sail the Starry Sky — Aureate Wake and layered water native Godot review frames
svg.desc: Two original unmodified 960 by 640 PNG frames from Godot 4.7.2 native OpenGL render workflow run 40662312067. Afloat after verified water physics, and at measured safe berth. Provisional layered water shader, wooden/copper hull and faceted dome; neither cinematic art acceptance nor sea travel/ship mode approval.
svg.text: TO SAIL THE STARRY SKY — FIRST WAKE / NATIVE WATER & BRIDGE REVIEW
Two original 960 × 640 renderer frames • exact Godot CI 40662312067 • draft-only and unapproved
